BEGIN;
-- Official placement diagnostics are a Student-owned, append-only aggregate.
-- They intentionally do not reference student_task_answer, learning_action,
-- evidence, mastery, progression, or any event/outbox table.
CREATE TABLE student_diagnostic_assessment_attempt (
    id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    student_id uuid NOT NULL,
    plan_id uuid NOT NULL,
    course_id uuid NOT NULL,
    plan_revision integer NOT NULL CHECK (plan_revision >= 1),
    policy_version varchar(64) NOT NULL CHECK (policy_version = 'diagnostic-fixed-v1'),
    onboarding_version bigint NOT NULL CHECK (onboarding_version >= 1),
    bootstrap_policy_version varchar(64) NOT NULL CHECK (bootstrap_policy_version = 'diagnostic-bootstrap-v1'),
    bootstrap_context_digest varchar(71) NOT NULL CHECK (bootstrap_context_digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    course_content_revision varchar(71) NOT NULL CHECK (course_content_revision ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    plan_digest varchar(71) NOT NULL CHECK (plan_digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    plan_json jsonb NOT NULL CHECK (
      jsonb_typeof(plan_json) = 'object' AND plan_json->>'schema' = 'diagnostic-assessment-plan.v1'
      AND plan_json->>'id' = plan_id::text AND plan_json->>'student_id' = student_id::text
      AND plan_json->>'course_id' = course_id::text AND plan_json->>'plan_revision' = plan_revision::text
      AND plan_json->>'policy_version' = policy_version AND plan_json->>'course_content_revision' = course_content_revision
      AND plan_json->>'onboarding_version' = onboarding_version::text
      AND plan_json->>'bootstrap_policy_version' = bootstrap_policy_version
      AND plan_json->>'bootstrap_context_digest' = bootstrap_context_digest
      AND plan_json->>'plan_digest' = plan_digest
      AND plan_json - ARRAY['schema','id','student_id','course_id','plan_revision','policy_version','onboarding_version','bootstrap_policy_version','bootstrap_context_digest','course_content_revision','plan_digest','assessments','created_at'] = '{}'::jsonb
      AND CASE WHEN plan_json->>'created_at' ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]+)?Z$' THEN (plan_json->>'created_at')::timestamptz = plan_created_at ELSE false END
      AND jsonb_typeof(plan_json->'assessments') = 'array'
      AND jsonb_array_length(plan_json->'assessments') BETWEEN 3 AND 5
    ),
    plan_created_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    reserved_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (student_id, plan_id, plan_revision),
    CHECK (id = plan_id)
);

CREATE TABLE student_diagnostic_assessment_item (
    attempt_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES student_diagnostic_assessment_attempt(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    task_id uuid NOT NULL,
    lesson_id uuid NOT NULL,
    task_version bigint NOT NULL CHECK (task_version > 0),
    task_updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    lesson_order integer NOT NULL CHECK (lesson_order >= 0),
    task_order integer NOT NULL CHECK (task_order >= 0),
    item_position integer NOT NULL CHECK (item_position BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
    learning_targets jsonb NOT NULL CHECK (jsonb_typeof(learning_targets) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(learning_targets) BETWEEN 1 AND 100),
    PRIMARY KEY (attempt_id, task_id),
    UNIQUE (attempt_id, item_position)
);

CREATE TABLE student_diagnostic_assessment_receipt (
    request_id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
    attempt_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES student_diagnostic_assessment_attempt(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    command_kind varchar(16) NOT NULL CHECK (command_kind IN ('RESERVE','SUBMIT','COMPLETE')),
    request_hash varchar(71) NOT NULL CHECK (request_hash ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    task_id uuid NULL,
    response_json jsonb NOT NULL CHECK (jsonb_typeof(response_json) = 'object'),
    created_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (request_id, attempt_id, task_id),
    CHECK ((command_kind='SUBMIT' AND task_id IS NOT NULL) OR (command_kind IN ('RESERVE','COMPLETE') AND task_id IS NULL)),
    UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT (attempt_id, command_kind, task_id)
);

CREATE TABLE student_diagnostic_assessment_submission (
    attempt_id uuid NOT NULL,
    task_id uuid NOT NULL,
    request_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    request_hash varchar(71) NOT NULL CHECK (request_hash ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    response_json jsonb NOT NULL CHECK (jsonb_typeof(response_json) = 'object'),
    correct boolean NOT NULL,
    submitted_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (attempt_id, task_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (request_id, attempt_id, task_id) REFERENCES student_diagnostic_assessment_receipt(request_id, attempt_id, task_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED,
    FOREIGN KEY (attempt_id, task_id) REFERENCES student_diagnostic_assessment_item(attempt_id, task_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);

CREATE TABLE student_diagnostic_assessment_result (
    attempt_id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES student_diagnostic_assessment_attempt(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    student_id uuid NOT NULL,
    course_id uuid NOT NULL,
    course_content_revision varchar(71) NOT NULL CHECK (course_content_revision ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    policy_version varchar(64) NOT NULL CHECK (policy_version = 'diagnostic-fixed-v1'),
    correct integer NOT NULL CHECK (correct >= 0),
    total integer NOT NULL CHECK (total BETWEEN 3 AND 5),
    percent integer NOT NULL CHECK (percent BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND percent = correct * 100 / total),
    band varchar(16) NOT NULL CHECK (band IN ('FOUNDATION','CORE','ADVANCED') AND ((percent < 50 AND band='FOUNDATION') OR (percent >= 50 AND percent < 80 AND band='CORE') OR (percent >= 80 AND band='ADVANCED'))),
    band_policy_version varchar(64) NOT NULL CHECK (band_policy_version = 'diagnostic-placement-band-v1'),
    completed_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
    result_digest varchar(71) NOT NULL CHECK (result_digest ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
    CHECK (correct <= total)
);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION student_diagnostic_assessment_immutable()
RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'diagnostic assessment records are immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514';
END;
$$;

CREATE TRIGGER student_diagnostic_assessment_attempt_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON student_diagnostic_assessment_attempt FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION student_diagnostic_assessment_immutable();
CREATE TRIGGER student_diagnostic_assessment_item_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON student_diagnostic_assessment_item FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION student_diagnostic_assessment_immutable();
CREATE TRIGGER student_diagnostic_assessment_receipt_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON student_diagnostic_assessment_receipt FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION student_diagnostic_assessment_immutable();
CREATE TRIGGER student_diagnostic_assessment_submission_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON student_diagnostic_assessment_submission FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION student_diagnostic_assessment_immutable();
CREATE TRIGGER student_diagnostic_assessment_result_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON student_diagnostic_assessment_result FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION student_diagnostic_assessment_immutable();
COMMIT;
